identity.what_it_is: A beach on the Arabian Sea within Hingol National Park, on Pakistan's Makran coast in Balochistan.
identity.where: Lasbela District, Balochistan, Pakistan, inside Hingol National Park, roughly 150 km from the Makran Coastal Highway's 'zero point' and about 150-180 km from Karachi.
identity.warnings: Hinglaj Mata Mandir (Nani Mandir), the major Hindu pilgrimage shrine, is inside Hingol National Park but is a distinct location from Kund Malir beach itself -- one Wikipedia sentence literally says the temple 'is located in kund malir' but this appears to conflate two separate sites; do not repeat without caveat. The 'Princess of Hope' rock formation is likewise elsewhere in Hingol NP, not at the beach. Sources disagree on the year Angelina Jolie visited and named the Princess of Hope rock: 2002 (Princess of Hope Wikipedia page) vs 2004 (Hingol National Park Wikipedia page and visitsilkroad.org). Several unsourced factoids ('11 active mud volcanoes', the 'Asia's 50 Most Beautiful Beaches 2018' list) recur verbatim across tour-operator sites with no attributed original publisher.

spike_candidates.statement: Angelina Jolie named Hingol's 'Princess of Hope' rock on a UN goodwill visit that Wikipedia itself dates to both 2002 and 2004.
spike_candidates.tension: The single most-repeated origin story about this coastline can't get its own headline fact straight.

spike_candidates.statement: The Makran Coastal Highway, finished 14 December 2004, cut the Karachi-Gwadar trip from two days to 6-7 hours, turning Kund Malir into a Karachi weekend day trip.
spike_candidates.tension: The very road that unlocked access to a 'wild, undeveloped' beach is what floods it with day-trippers and erodes the remoteness it is marketed on.

spike_candidates.statement: Olive ridley and green turtles used to nest nightly on nearby Makran beaches every August, but rising plastic pollution has driven females away before they lay eggs.
spike_candidates.tension: The 'pristine nature' pitch is quietly failing on the very shoreline it's sold on, and no harvested source gives a current turtle count to say how bad.

facts.fact: Kund Malir is a beach in Balochistan, Pakistan, located within Hingol National Park.
facts.quote: kund malir is a beach in balochistan , pakistan located in hingol national park .

facts.fact: The beach sits about 150 km from the Makran Coastal Highway's 'zero point'.
facts.quote: it is located about 150 kilometres (93 mi) from zero-point on makran coastal highway .

facts.fact: Hingol National Park, which contains the beach, lies about 236.8 km west of Karachi, Pakistan's largest city.
facts.quote: hingol national park is one of the largest national parks in pakistan. it is located 236.8 kilometres (147.1 mi) west of karachi , the largest city of pakistan .

facts.fact: Past the Makran Coastal Highway's zero point, no food or fuel facilities exist along the route to Kund Malir.
facts.quote: after passing zero point, there are no food or fuel facilities available along the route.

facts.fact: Wikipedia states there are an estimated 11 active mud volcanoes at Kund Malir, but flags the figure as uncited, and it recurs verbatim across tour sites with no attributed source.
facts.quote: there are estimated to be 11 active mud volcanoes in kund malir.

facts.fact: Kund Malir was added to a list of Asia's 50 most beautiful beaches in 2018, though no harvested source names the original list's publisher.
facts.quote: the beach was added to the list of asia's 50 most beautiful beaches in 2018.

facts.fact: Mobile carrier Ufone extended network coverage into the rural Kund Malir region in response to rising tourism.
facts.quote: due to increase in tourism, some of the mobile networks, including ufone , have established service to provide coverage in this rural region.

facts.fact: Kund Malir functions as a popular weekend picnic and day-trip destination for residents of Karachi and interior Sindh.
facts.quote: kund malir is a popular weekend picnic and daytrip destination for people from karachi and interior sindh .

facts.fact: English Wikipedia's Kund Malir article states the Hindu temple Hinglaj Mata Mandir 'is located in Kund Malir', though this appears to conflate two distinct sites within Hingol National Park (see identity warning).
facts.quote: the prominent hindu temple hinglaj mata mandir is located in kund malir .

facts.fact: Kund Malir's coordinates are approximately 25.39 N, 65.46 E on the Arabian Sea coast.
Hingol National Park, which contains the beach, was declared a national park in 1988.
facts.quote: hingol was declared a national park in 1988 .

facts.fact: Hingol National Park covers about 6,100 sq km spanning Gwadar, Lasbela and Awaran districts of Balochistan.
facts.quote: the park covers an area of about 6,100 square kilometres (2,400 sq mi) and is located 200 km northwest of karachi in the three districts of gwadar , lasbela and awaran in balochistan.

facts.fact: The park's rock formations have drawn nationwide tourism only since the Makran Coastal Highway was completed in 2004.
facts.quote: the park's unique rock formations have been attracting tourists from all over the country since the completion of the makran coastal highway in 2004 .

facts.fact: An estimated 60 marsh crocodiles are found along the coastline adjacent to Hingol National Park.
facts.quote: there are an estimated 60 crocodiles in various places .

facts.fact: Green and olive ridley turtles historically nested on nearby Makran beaches every night in August, but rising plastic pollution has made nesting harder and turtle numbers have dropped sharply.
facts.quote: these turtles come to the beach every night in august to lay their eggs at night.

facts.fact: The 'Princess of Hope' and 'Balochistan Sphinx' are the park's two most notable wind- and wave-eroded rock formations.
facts.quote: the most notable of these rocks are the princess of hope and the balochistan sphinx .

facts.fact: Per the Hingol National Park Wikipedia article, Angelina Jolie named the Princess of Hope formation during a 2004 UN goodwill visit (conflicts with the Princess of Hope article's 2002 date -- see conflicts).
facts.quote: when american actress angelina jolie came to pakistan on a un goodwill mission in 2004 , this rock formation caught her attention and inspired her to name it 'princess of hope' .

facts.fact: Hingol's mud volcanoes range from 800 to 1,500 feet in height and are concentrated mostly in the Mid-Hor area.
facts.quote: hingol mud volcanoes ranging in height from 800 to 1500 feet are abundant in hingol national park, mostly in the mid-hor area.

facts.fact: The Hinglaj Mata Mandir shrine draws over 250,000 pilgrims to the center of Hingol National Park every spring.
facts.quote: is a site of a pilgrimage bringing over 250,000 pilgrims to its location at the center of hingol national park every spring

facts.fact: The annual Hinglaj pilgrimage festival is attended by 20,000-30,000 people and is organized by a committee of Sindh and Balochistan Hindus.
facts.quote: the annual festival is attended by 20,000 to 30,000 people and is organized by a committee of leading hindus from sindh and balochistan.

facts.fact: Because only four passenger train compartments serve the Hinglaj pilgrimage route, most pilgrims sleep in tents or exposed under trees.
facts.quote: there are only four passenger compartments, so most pilgrims stay in tents, while many have to stay under trees or exposed to the sun.

facts.fact: The beach adjacent to Kund Malir, also called 'virgin beach', was added to a list of Asia's 50 most beautiful beaches in 2018.
facts.quote: the beach adjacent to kand malir on the last corner of hingol national park, also known as 'virgin beach', was added to the list of asia's 50 most beautiful beaches in 2018 .

facts.fact: Kund Malir is also called the 'Golden Beach' and is considered one of Pakistan's most beautiful beaches for its clear water.
facts.quote: the kand malir beach, also known as the "golden beach", is considered one of the most beautiful beaches of pakistan due to its clear water.

facts.fact: The Hingol National Park team has more than 20 members drawn from Wildlife Pakistan and the provincial livestock, environment and tourism department, though reform is still needed.
facts.quote: the hangul national park team consists of more than 20 members, including the wildlife pakistan, the provincial department of livestock, environment and tourism.

facts.fact: Twenty staff members, 18 game watchers and 2 deputy rangers are responsible for managing Hingol National Park.
facts.quote: 20 staff members, 18 game watchers and 2 deputy rangers are responsible for the management of the park.

facts.fact: Hingol National Park is home to roughly 257 plant and 289 animal species, including 35 mammal species.
facts.quote: it is home to about 257 plant and 289 animal species, including 35 mammals, aquatic animals, amphibians, reptiles and migratory birds, including hundreds of rare species.

facts.fact: A joint University of Geneva/University of Tehran study documented 36 distinct wind- and wave-eroded rock formations along this coastal strip.
facts.quote: the university of geneva and the university of tehran conducted a joint study on the attractive features of this coastal strip of iran and balochistan, in which 36 rock formations were observed.

facts.fact: The Makran Coastal Highway (N-10) is a 653 km road running along the Arabian Sea coast from Karachi to Gwadar.
facts.quote: the n-10 or national highway 10 ( urdu : قومی شاہراہ ۱۰ ) is a 653 km national highway in pakistan which extends along arabian sea coast from karachi in sindh province to gwadar in balochistan province.

facts.fact: Before the highway existed, the Karachi-Gwadar trip on an uncarpeted dirt track took at least two days and was hard on vehicles.
facts.quote: the journey between karachi and gwadar used to take at least two days and took a heavy toll on the "wear and tear" of vehicles.

facts.fact: After the Makran Coastal Highway opened, Karachi-Gwadar travel time fell to just 6-7 hours and transport costs dropped.
facts.quote: after completion of the makran coastal highway, the average journey time between karachi and gwadar has been reduced to only 6 to 7 hours and transportation costs have also been reduced.

facts.fact: Construction of the Makran Coastal Highway began in 2002 and finished on 14 December 2004, a three-year build by the Frontier Works Organisation.
facts.quote: construction work on the makran coastal highway project commenced in 2002 and was completed by 14 december 2004, in a period of three years.

facts.fact: The Princess of Hope rock formation sits about 190 km from Karachi and 717 km from Quetta, within Hingol NP's Lasbela district -- a nearby but separate landmark from Kund Malir beach.
facts.quote: it is situated approximately 190 km (120 mi) from pakistan's financial hub , karachi , and approximately 717 km (446 mi) from the provincial capital, quetta .

facts.fact: The Princess of Hope Wikipedia article dates Angelina Jolie's visit and naming of the rock to 2002, as a UN goodwill ambassador (conflicts with the Hingol NP article's 2004 date -- see conflicts).
facts.quote: the formation was given the name princess of hope by hollywood actress angelina jolie , who visited pakistan - including the hingol national park - in the year 2002 as a un goodwill ambassador .

facts.fact: Wikidata classifies Kund Malir as a beach located within the protected area of Hingol National Park.
facts.quote: located in protected area hingol national park

facts.fact: Wikimedia Commons places Kund Malir Beach in Lasbela District, Kalat Division, Balochistan, Pakistan.
facts.quote: location lasbela district , kalat division , balochistan , pakistan
facts.source_title: Category:Kund Malir Beach, Pakistan - Wikimedia Commons

facts.quote: this page was last edited on 31 july 2026, at 22:08 .
facts.source_title: Category:Kund Malir Beach, Pakistan - Wikimedia Commons

facts.fact: The English Wikipedia article on Kund Malir was itself most recently edited 6 July 2026.
facts.quote: this page was last edited on 6 july 2026, at 20:51 (utc) .

facts.fact: A regional tourism-board guide puts Hingol National Park about 180 km from Karachi and 120 km from Uthal, reachable by normal vehicle on the highway but needing 4x4 to explore further.
facts.quote: it is approximately 180km karachi city and 120km from uthal city. normal vehicles will only be able to get you on the main highway, however 4×4 vehicles are needed to explore it.
facts.source_title: Hingol National Park - Visit Silk Road

facts.fact: Guest houses are available on Kund Malir beach itself, serving as a base to reach nearby Hingol National Park attractions, per a regional tourism-board guide.
facts.quote: there is total coverage of ufone network on the main highway and there are guest houses available on the kund malir beach from where all the mentioned places are easily accessible.
facts.source_title: Hingol National Park - Visit Silk Road

facts.fact: Fuel quality along the route is unreliable, since most fuel stations lack high-quality fuel, per the same tourism-board guide.
facts.quote: fuel might be an issue because most of the fuel stations don't have high quality fuel available.
facts.source_title: Hingol National Park - Visit Silk Road

facts.fact: The coastal route through Hingol NP was historically used by soldiers of Muhammad bin Qasim, whose 8th-century graves lie near Agore village, and for centuries by barefoot Hindu pilgrims heading to Hinglaj Mata.
facts.quote: this route was historically used by the soldiers of muhammad bin qasim as evident from their graves near the village of agore.
facts.source_title: Hingol National Park - Visit Silk Road

facts.fact: A regional tourism-board guide also dates Angelina Jolie's visit and the Princess of Hope naming to 2004, agreeing with the Hingol NP Wikipedia page but conflicting with the Princess of Hope Wikipedia page's 2002 date.
facts.quote: hingol national park is home to the princess of hope as named by angelina julie when she visited pakistan in 2004.
facts.source_title: Hingol National Park - Visit Silk Road
